purpose: Test whether broad Defensive-GA chromosomes transport to an entire declining-market episode not used for evolution.
rules: Same feature language, chromosome representation, execution semantics, costs, fitness weights and GA bounds as main discovery.
For each fold, the held-out episode is excluded from fitness, hard-gate counts and condition-quantile estimation.
GA evolves only on the other five consumed episodes.
The winning training chromosome is then reported unchanged on the held-out episode.
Held-out episode results cannot alter that fold's chromosome.
No TEST17, preserved-50, remaining Discovery or Verification A/B access.
